storage.notes: No onboard storage. Requires eufy NVR E50 or NVR S4 (S4 needs firmware V4.2.2.8+). Records to the NVR.

features: Hybrid bullet-PTZ dual-lens: upper 2K fixed lens (115) + lower 4K PTZ lens
360 tracking with 5x digital zoom (details up to 65 ft / 20 m)
dual night vision: full-color with spotlight or discreet IR
PoE single-cable power + data up to 330 ft
smart video search, no subscription fee

frigate.notes: PoE add-on camera; requires a eufy NVR E50/S4 to operate. eufy PoE cameras do not expose a standard ONVIF/RTSP stream directly to third-party NVRs.

home_assistant.notes: Managed via the eufy NVR system; use the eufy-security HACS integration.

blue_iris.notes: Camera is bound to the eufy NVR; no confirmed direct ONVIF/RTSP for third-party recorders.
